## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与修改后行为

Describe the trigger, expected result and scope. / 描述触发条件、预期结果和修改范围。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `make check test vet build` passed / 本地检查、测试和编译通过
- [ ] Relevant Docker tests passed, or explain why not / 相关 Docker 测试通过，或说明未执行原因
- [ ] English and Chinese docs agree / 中英文文档同步
- [ ] No credentials, local configuration or private logs included / 不包含凭据、本地配置或私人日志

## Compatibility and deployment / 兼容性与部署

Explain changed interfaces and any required migration or restart. / 说明接口变化及是否需要迁移或重启。
